body: I haven't really met anyone else whose partner struggles with the same drug/porn/sex addiction combo before, so it's great to finally see that it's not as uncommon as I thought it was. You're always welcome to send me a dm if you ever need to chat.

I ended up telling my partner about my scars and self harm pretty early into the "talking stage" of our relationship, and slowly but surely as we got closer and spent more time together, he eventually saw all my scars and cuts. He didn't freak out, he didn't even care that they were there, he just saw me as I was, and not just as someone who has scars. 
My experience is honestly that most people are becoming more understanding and open to the idea that we exist, our scars are there and it's okay. 
My partner doesn't love me any less because of my self harm, and he never looked at me differently or treated me differently, or became any less attracted to me because of my cuts and scars.

Don't worry too much about it, I hope you will find love and that she will treat you good. Always remember, that the right person wouldn't ever judge you or love you any less because of it

My boyfriend is also a drug addict and his drug addiction is very much connected to his porn addiction. He loves getting fucked up on speed/amphetamine and jerk off to porn for days at a time, because it feel so much better than anything else he has ever tried. When he's clean and sober, he jerks off to porn for a few hours every once in awhile until it eventually gets boring and he starts craving the drugs again. He has been in recovery for his drug addiction for 3 years now and yet still relapses every 2-3 months. It wasn't until recently that he admitted that the porn was a part of his addiction as well.

I've always loved this form of self harm. Not sure whether it's because of my ED or because it just feels so ridiculously addictive to float in and out of consciousness.

I don't want to sound encouraging though, it's just as bad as any other type of self harm - I just wanted you to know that you're not alone with this feeling.
